selection.ranking: Latest dated non-deprecated headcount; undated only if no dated count. Ties prefer preferred rank, then higher count. Descending employee count; unknown counts last.
selection.sanity_rules: Withhold manually flagged outliers, counts above 5 million or more than tenfold the preceding dated positive count; retain employer as unranked pending review. Deduplicate identical display names.
selection.singapore_selection: Retained seed businesses with Singapore country or headquarters; conflicting non-Singapore headquarters excluded during seed review.
